_note: Field centres were measured by diffing example_empty.png against example_filled.png. Coordinates are original-template pixels (3080x1993); the render is downscaled to output_width afterwards.
font_note: `font` is the default face; each field may override it. To use the intended faces, drop YaModernPro.ttf / GodofThunder.ttf / Munro.ttf into assets/fonts/ and set the per-field `font` values below (real_name + facebook_name -> YaModernPro, bank_number -> Munro, username -> GodofThunder). Until then everything uses the bundled Readex Pro, which covers Arabic, Latin and digits.
fill_note: Glyphs are a vertical black->grey gradient with a white outline. `color` is only the fallback when `gradient` is removed.
font_size_note: Readex Pro is wider per glyph than the artwork's font, so 84 matches the design's height without overflowing the bar.
